The '''Strafe Plains''' was a region prone to localized [[Force Storm (Tython)|Force storms]] located on the continent of [[Kato Zakar]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. The scrubland lay between the [[Ice Giant Range]] and the north coastline, and its rough, cold terrain was littered with sharp, slanted columns of silica and sinkholes. Filled with magma, the latter posed a peril as they could form suddenly without warning. Fortunately for travelers, the native [[spinner bird]]s could be relied upon to avoid this danger, as they flew spirals around any area about to erupt. Besides these birds, the region was also home to [[flame tygah]]s, which formed their dens underneath mounds of detritus thrown up by emerging sinkholes.
